title: Membership in the relevant coordinates
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the sign cube with $n$ coordinates, and let $i$ be one of those coordinates. Then $i$ belongs to the set of relevant coordinates of $f$ if and only if the influence of $f$ at $i$ is positive.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-coordinate sign cube
$i$ is a coordinate among the $n$ coordinates
